user.description: Choose the safe to set up. Touch its keypad if it is not listed.

no_devices.title: No safe found
no_devices.description: Home Assistant can't hear a Populife safe right now. Touch the safe's keypad to wake it, make sure a Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome proxy is within a few metres, then scan again.

method.description: How should Home Assistant get the Bluetooth key for {name}?

menu_options.cloud: Import it from my TTLock-family account
menu_options.app_data: Paste the lock data copied from the app

reauth_confirm.title: Replace key
reauth_confirm.description: {name} rejected its Bluetooth key, for example because it was revoked or the safe was reset. How should Home Assistant get the new key?

menu_options.cloud: Import it from my TTLock-family account
menu_options.app_data: Paste the lock data copied from the app

reconfigure.title: Replace key
reconfigure.description: Replace the Bluetooth key Home Assistant uses for {name}, for example to add the admin password. How should Home Assistant get the new key?

menu_options.cloud: Import it from my TTLock-family account
menu_options.app_data: Paste the lock data copied from the app

cloud.title: Import key from cloud
cloud.description: Sign in with the account the safe is paired to. Home Assistant downloads the key for {name} once and does not store your password; every command afterwards runs locally over Bluetooth.

data_description.back: Turn this on and submit to go back to the method choice. The other fields are ignored.

cloud_verify.title: Confirm new device
cloud_verify.description: The cloud sent a verification code to {email}. Enter it to allow this Home Assistant install.

data_description.back: Turn this on and submit to go back to the method choice. The other fields are ignored.

app_data.title: Paste lock data
app_data.description: Paste the lock details JSON for {name} exactly as the Populife (or TTLock) app's sync response shows it, for example the response of its lock details request captured with a proxy app on your phone. Home Assistant reads the AES key, unlock key, admin password, flag position and firmware ids from it, and connects once to check the key. Touch the keypad before submitting.

data_description.lock_data: The whole response, its data object, or a list of key records. It must contain this safe's MAC address.
data_description.back: Turn this on and submit to go back to the method choice. The other fields are ignored.

manual.title: Enter key
manual.description: Enter the secrets for {name}. Touch the keypad before submitting so the safe is awake; Home Assistant connects once to check the key.

data_description.aes_key: 16 bytes as hex, either continuous (32 characters) or comma separated.
data_description.unlock_key: The numeric unlock key, or the encoded lockKey value exactly as the app's sync data shows it.
data_description.admin_password: Optional. The adminPwd value (plain digits or encoded) from the app's sync data, not the keypad "Admin code" shown in the app. Leave it empty unless you have it.
data_description.group_id: The groupId value from the app's sync data. Keep 1 unless you know it.
data_description.org_id: The orgId value from the app's sync data. Keep 1 unless you know it.
data_description.flag_pos: The flagPos value from the app's sync data. Needed with the admin password; keep 0 otherwise.
data_description.back: Turn this on and submit to go back to the method choice. The other fields are ignored.

error.invalid_code: The verification code was not accepted.
error.lock_not_in_account: This safe is not in that account. Pair it in the app first, or enter the key manually.
error.invalid_unlock_key: Enter the unlock key as digits or as the encoded lockKey value.
error.invalid_admin_password: Enter the admin password as digits or as the encoded adminPwd value.
error.invalid_json: That isn't valid JSON. Paste the response exactly as the app sent it.
error.not_lock_data: No lock key data found. Paste the response that contains aesKey (or aesKeyStr).
error.wrong_safe: This data belongs to a different safe. Its MAC address doesn't match.

abort.no_devices_found: No devices found on the network
abort.not_supported: This device does not look like a Populife or TTLock safe.

command_failed.message: The safe did not complete the command: {error}

device_not_found.message: No connectable Bluetooth adapter or proxy can reach {address}. Touch the keypad to wake the safe and try again.

key_rejected.message: The safe rejected the Bluetooth key ({error}). Replace the key when Settings > Devices & services asks you to re-authenticate.

auto_lock_too_short.message: The safe accepts an auto-lock delay of 0 (off) or at least {min} seconds.

admin_required.message: Managing keypad passcodes needs an admin key. Use Reconfigure to add the safe's Bluetooth admin password.

passcode_period_invalid.message: A temporary passcode needs a "valid until" later than its "valid from".

passcode_conflict.message: {code} clashes with another passcode: one starts with the other, so the keypad would accept the shorter one. Pick another code.

passcode_missing.message: Fill in the passcode first, or press Generate passcode.

low_battery.title: {name} battery is low
low_battery.description: The battery of {name} is at {battery}%. Replace the batteries soon so the safe keeps opening; keep a physical way in until then.

add_passcode.name: Add passcode
add_passcode.description: Adds a keypad passcode to the safe. Without an end it is permanent; with an end it only works between start and end. Needs an admin key.

code.name: Passcode
code.description: 4 to 9 digits. Avoid codes that start with another active code: the keypad may match the shorter one.

start.name: Start
start.description: When a time-limited passcode starts working. Defaults to now.

end.name: End
end.description: When the passcode stops working. Leave empty for a permanent passcode.

name.name: Name
name.description: Who the code belongs to, or what a temporary code is for. Home Assistant keeps the name; the safe stores only the digits.

delete_passcode.name: Delete passcode
delete_passcode.description: Removes a keypad passcode from the safe. Needs an admin key.

clear_passcodes.name: Clear all passcodes
clear_passcodes.description: Removes every keypad passcode from the safe, including ones created in the app. This can't be undone. Needs an admin key.

list_passcodes.name: List passcodes
list_passcodes.description: Returns the keypad passcodes the safe reports. Codes created in the app may only appear after they have been used once. Needs an admin key.

list_fingerprints.name: List fingerprints
list_fingerprints.description: Returns the enrolled fingerprints with their slot and validity period. Needs an admin key.
